name: tnValueNet
purpose: Evaluates: estimates three numbers about an expression (such as its dimension and its number of terms), checked against exact values from the symbolic engine.
structure: Input (20 tokens); embedding 128; Dims (1 per token); per-token layer 128; add; encoder 3 × (4 heads, FF 512 GELU); Mean pool; 128 GELU; regression, 3 outputs (Estimate)
